description: Kautas wears a dark navy knee-length textured wool-like tunic with tan geometric borders at the neckline, cuffs and lower hem. A cream linen-like underlayer shows at the neck, wrists and lower edge. Two round silver-toned brooches connected by a small bar fasten the chest. A broad brown leather-like belt with rectangular buckle, round fittings and a long hanging end cinches the waist. Brown textured trousers lead to tall brown boots with crossing straps around the upper shafts. Exact fibers are uncertain. Clothing is opaque with modest metal ornament and no headgear, armor, weapon or oversized fur.
